messages.text:
BL-990 — a misattributed bounce is permanent: record-bounce.js has no correction verb and its --role enum cannot name the specifier, so an amendment-caused bounce is charged to a pipeline role forever
What it solves: Source: the BL-971 amendment-supersession incident, evidence committed at backlog/evidence/BL-971-amendment-supersession-20260820.md (f98d902c7). QA's own correction broadcast is 20260820T140003Z_000425.
The specifier caused the incident and is filing the ticket; that is deliberate rather than awkw…
Approval context: One choice left open deliberately: whether a correction RE-ATTRIBUTES the bounce (which needs `specifier` added to the --role enum) or simply marks the record excluded from attribution with a reason. The second is smaller, needs no enum change, and fixes the live contamination; the first is more tr…
BL-990 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-990" (or "reject BL-990 <reason>") to act.
